title: Claim
description: EIP-712 typed claim submitted to the ClaimRegistry. The router (see RQ5) decides whether this claim takes the optimistic path or routes directly to arbitration based on the attached effect+recovery receipts and the κ.

claimant.description: Address claiming residual loss (typically the customer, possibly the operator if they self-attest).

amount.description: Asserted residual loss in token base units. Must be <= κ.payoutRule.maxPayout.

evidenceCid.description: Content identifier (sha256 hex or IPFS CIDv1) pointing at the canonical evidence bundle in the evidence store.

routeHint.description: Claimant's preferred route. The router treats this as a hint only — failing settleability predicates force arbitration regardless.
